BiblicalUsage: Meristes is a divider, one who apportions an inheritance between brothers. Luke 12:14 has Jesus refuse the office: Man, who made Me a judge or a divider over you?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus refused the divider's seat because He came to give an inheritance, not to split one.
